WHO estimates 59 000 rabies deaths a year. For 2024 the world's health ministries wrote down 3 021 — and 94 of the 194 countries WHO asks, India among them, filed nothing at all

REPORTED deaths, not deaths. Grey is not zero: 94 countries filed nothing for 2024, India and China and Pakistan among them, and are drawn as no reading. 44 countries did file, and reported zero — those are shaded as the lowest class. Raw counts of people, never a rate: this file carries no population. French Guiana reported 3 and has no shape of its own in Natural Earth, so those 3 are drawn nowhere on this map — 3 018 of the 3 021 are.
